The scene will be designed so that the redstone_torch serves as a visual landmark/guide that leads the player toward the black_wool. The player must first locate the redstone_torch (which emits a distinctive red glow, making it visible from a distance), and following the direction it indicates or the path it illuminates will lead them to the black_wool. This creates a natural multi-hop navigation challenge: find the glowing torch first, then use it as a waypoint to discover the black wool block. Both items are visually distinctive and easily verifiable without deep Minecraft domain knowledge.
